translation: 本项目简体中文译文；检索词为本项目编写，非原题库内容。

items.english: Oppression by corporations is more of a concern than oppression by governments.
items.text: 比起政府的压迫，我更担心企业的压迫。

items.english: It is necessary for the government to intervene in the economy to protect consumers.
items.text: 政府有必要干预经济以保护消费者。

items.english: The freer the markets, the freer the people.
items.text: 市场越自由，人民就越自由。

items.english: It is better to maintain a balanced budget than to ensure welfare for all citizens.
items.text: 保持预算平衡比保障所有公民的福利更重要。

items.english: Publicly-funded research is more beneficial to the people than leaving it to the market.
items.text: 相比把研究交给市场，公共资金资助的研究对人民更有益。

items.english: Tariffs on international trade are important to encourage local production.
items.text: 对国际贸易征收关税对鼓励本国生产很重要。

items.english: From each according to his ability, to each according to his needs.
items.text: 各尽所能，按需分配。

items.english: It would be best if social programs were abolished in favor of private charity.
items.text: 最好取消社会福利项目，改由私人慈善来承担。

items.english: Taxes should be increased on the rich to provide for the poor.
items.text: 应该提高对富人的税收来帮助穷人。

items.english: Inheritance is a legitimate form of wealth.
items.text: 继承遗产是一种正当的财富来源。

items.english: Basic utilities like roads and electricity should be publicly owned.
items.text: 道路和电力等基础公共设施应该公有。

items.english: Government intervention is a threat to the economy.
items.text: 政府干预会威胁经济。

items.english: Those with a greater ability to pay should receive better healthcare.
items.text: 支付能力更强的人应该得到更好的医疗服务。

items.english: Quality education is a right of all people.
items.text: 优质教育是所有人的权利。

items.english: The means of production should belong to the workers who use them.
items.text: 生产资料应该属于使用它们的工人。

items.english: The United Nations should be abolished.
items.text: 应该废除联合国。

items.english: Military action by our nation is often necessary to protect it.
items.text: 我国采取军事行动往往是保护国家所必需的。

items.english: I support regional unions, such as the European Union.
items.text: 我支持欧盟这样的区域联盟。

items.english: It is important to maintain our national sovereignty.
items.text: 维护我国的国家主权很重要。

items.english: Wars do not need to be justified to other countries.
items.text: 发动战争不需要向其他国家说明正当理由。

items.english: Military spending is a waste of money.
items.text: 军费开支是在浪费钱。

items.english: International aid is a waste of money.
items.text: 国际援助是在浪费钱。

items.english: Governments should be accountable to the international community.
items.text: 政府应该向国际社会负责。

items.english: Even when protesting an authoritarian government, violence is not acceptable.
items.text: 即使是在抗议威权政府时，暴力也是不可接受的。

items.english: My religious values should be spread as much as possible.
items.text: 我的宗教价值观应该尽可能广泛地传播。

items.english: Our nation's values should be spread as much as possible.
items.text: 我国的价值观应该尽可能广泛地传播。

items.english: It is very important to maintain law and order.
items.text: 维护法律与秩序非常重要。

items.english: The general populace makes poor decisions.
items.text: 普通民众会做出糟糕的决定。

items.english: Physician-assisted suicide should be legal.
items.text: 医生协助自杀应该合法。

items.english: The sacrifice of some civil liberties is necessary to protect us from acts of terrorism.
items.text: 为了保护我们免受恐怖袭击，有必要牺牲一部分公民自由。

items.english: Government surveillance is necessary in the modern world.
items.text: 在现代世界，政府监控是必要的。

items.english: The very existence of the state is a threat to our liberty.
items.text: 国家的存在本身就威胁着我们的自由。

items.english: Regardless of political opinions, it is important to side with your country.
items.text: 无论持有什么政治观点，站在自己国家一边都很重要。

items.english: All authority should be questioned.
items.text: 所有权威都应该受到质疑。

items.english: A hierarchical state is best.
items.text: 等级分明的国家最好。

items.english: It is important that the government follows the majority opinion, even if it is wrong.
items.text: 政府遵循多数人的意见很重要，即使多数人的意见是错的。

items.english: The stronger the leadership, the better.
items.text: 领导越强有力越好。

items.english: Democracy is more than a decision-making process.
items.text: 民主不仅仅是一种决策程序。

items.english: Environmental regulations are essential.
items.text: 环境监管必不可少。

items.english: Children should be educated in religious or traditional values.
items.text: 应该教育儿童接受宗教价值观或传统价值观。

items.english: Religion should play a role in government.
items.text: 宗教应该在政府中发挥作用。

items.english: Churches should be taxed the same way other institutions are taxed.
items.text: 教会应该和其他机构一样纳税。

items.english: Drug use should be legalized or decriminalized.
items.text: 吸毒应该合法化或非刑事化。

items.english: Same-sex marriage should be legal.
items.text: 同性婚姻应该合法。

items.english: No cultures are superior to others.
items.text: 没有哪种文化比其他文化更优越。

items.english: Sex outside marriage is immoral.
items.text: 婚姻以外（包括婚前）的性行为是不道德的。

items.english: If we accept migrants at all, it is important that they assimilate into our culture.
items.text: 如果我们接受移民，他们融入我们的文化很重要。

items.english: Abortion should be prohibited in most or all cases.
items.text: 在大多数或所有情况下，都应该禁止堕胎。

items.english: Gun ownership should be prohibited for those without a valid reason.
items.text: 没有正当理由的人应该被禁止拥有枪支。

items.english: I support single-payer, universal healthcare.
items.text: 我支持单一支付方的全民医疗制度。

items.english: Prostitution should be illegal.
items.text: 卖淫应该是非法的。

items.english: We should open our borders to immigration.
items.text: 我们应该向移民开放边境。

items.english: All people - regardless of factors like culture or sexuality - should be treated equally.
items.text: 所有人都应该受到平等对待，不论其文化或性取向等因素。

items.english: It is important that we further my group's goals above all others.
items.text: 我们应该把推动自己群体的目标置于所有其他群体之上，这很重要。
